Reusable public links for your website: a buy button for a one-time product, or a subscribe button for a plan. Each visitor gets their own checkout, so one link serves any number of buyers. Archive a link to stop it; its past checkouts are kept.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_links`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-links/list-payment-links) | List payment links |
| `POST` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_links`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-links/create-a-reusable-payment-link) | Create a reusable payment link |
| `GET` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_links/{plink}`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-links/retrieve-a-payment-link) | Retrieve a payment link, with its opens and completed checkouts |
| `PATCH` | [`/v1/businesses/{biz}/payment_links/{plink}`](/help/developers/api-reference/payment-links/rename) | Rename, archive or restore a payment link |
